jobs.title: About TA9
jobs.description: About TA9 | TA9 Ltd Home Solutions Use Cases Partners About Careers Knowledge Center Contact Us Home Solutions Use Cases Partners About Careers Knowledge Center Contact Us ABOUT US The Intelligence Behind the Intelligence TA9 Ltd is an Israeli technology company specializing in big data analytics and intelligence platforms. We build the tools that help organizations see what others miss. 0 + Use Cases Across Domains 0 + Integrated Applications 0 + Years Experience 0 Continents OUR STORY Built by Intelligence Practitioners TA9 was founded over a decade ago by practitioners who understood the gap between the data organizations collect and the intelligence they could actually use. Traditional BI tools were designed for business metrics — not for complex investigative analysis, real-time operational intelligence, or entity-centric reasoning. We built IntSight to solve the hardest problems in law enforcement and enterprise analytics: federated search across heterogeneous data, graph-based relationship discovery, and a self-service experience that empowers analysts who aren't data scientists. IntSight - KYC followed as we recognized the KYC compliance market needed the same intelligence-grade approach — automated, accurate, and built for the scale modern financial institutions require. Today, TA9 serves organizations across law enforcement, intelligence, enterprise, and financial sectors on three continents. Our platforms are deployed in some of the most demanding environments in the world. 2013 TA9 founded in Israel, first IntSight prototype deployed for law enforcement. 2015 IntSight 1.0 commercially launched. First international deployment. 2018 IntSight Enterprise V3.x product line launched. Expanded to worldwide clients and projects in different domains. 2023 IntSight Enterprise V4.x product line launched. 2025 IntSight - KYC V1 launched. TA9 recives ISO 27001 certification. 2026 IntSight - KYC V2 launched. IntSight V4.6.0 released. What Drives Us Mission-Driven We exist to give organizations the intelligence edge they need to make better decisions faster — whether protecting national security or protecting customers. Clarity from Complexity We believe that buried in every dataset is a clear answer. Our platforms surface it — without requiring a data scientist or weeks of analysis. Built for People Technology is only as powerful as the people using it. We design intuitive, fast interfaces that analysts love — not just tolerate. Global Impact Our platforms protect communities, enable financial compliance, and empower organizations across 3 continents to act on intelligence. jobs.description: Senior Backend Software Developer Position Summary: We're looking for an impact-driven team player with 5–7 years of backend software development experience to join our team. This role calls for a multidisciplinary backend developer who thrives on working with cutting-edge technologies alongside a strong, senior-caliber engineering team. Above all, we're looking for someone who brings their own personality and perspective to a dynamic, fast-growing company someone who makes the team better just by being in it. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience. Proven experience as a .NET Core Developer, deep understanding of backend development. Experience in developing REST APIs, working with Micro-Services / Docker & Container. Experience working according to agile development methodologies. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment. A clear communicator who works well with others, both inside and outside the engineering team. Nice to Have: Experience working in startups with heavy data processing processes. Experience with other dev languages: Java, Python,, AI. Experience with a variety of DB types. Experience with database (NoSQL/SQL) design and optimization. Academic education — Computer Science / Industrial Engineering & Management / graduate engineer in a computer major. Please send your CV to careers@t-a9.com
